messages:
jess: Quick sync - posting a short design follow-up about Finalization Routing + Adaptive Windows for metering. Want to capture tradeoffs and rollout safety.
pradeep: high level?
jess: ingest continues to emit provisional tokens to staging topic. New Finalizer service consumes staging, groups by fingerprint, and decides per-fingerprint strategy: immediate fast-path (micro-finalize) or convergence-window. Decision uses recent-arrival-rate + tenant SLA.
eva: why not one-size merge window?
jess: tradeoffs: fixed long window increases audit determinism but delays final numbers and increases user confusion. adaptive windows balance tail latency for small tenants while preserving correctness for hot fingerprints.
pradeep: storage/audit plan?
jess: raw provisional events -> immutable cold S3 (90d). Finalizer writes a compact provenance record to audit-db (fingerprint, input_ids, blob_hashes, source_region, finalization_reason). Audit record TTL 30d. For every finalized event we write an audit manifest containing input hashes and merge decisions for debugging.
eva: replay and rollback?
jess: support deterministic reprocess: re-run finalizer logic on raw blobs and emit a canonical patch stream with tombstones. We'll keep a replay-manifest with sequence ranges and checksums so consumers can validate. Ops guarded by replay-quarantine and rate limits.
pradeep: commit key example?
jess: single-line example: commit_key = "{tenant_id}|{fingerprint}|{window_start}|{finalizer_version}". If commit_key exists skip emit. Also write WAL marker before publish.
ops-bot: NOTE: replay-quarantine enabled. Large patch runs will auto-escalate.
billing-bot: API impact? clients want immediate visibility of usage.
jess: API continues to show provisional immediately with a provenance_id. Finalized numbers land later; adjustments are emitted as separate delta events with audit links. Console will show provisional vs finalized side-by-side.
eva: ops metrics?
jess: dashboards: pending_finalizations_by_shard, avg_finalization_time, provisional_to_final_diff_rate, reprocess_errors. Alerts when diff_rate > 1% or reprocess backlog > X.
pradeep: rollout?
jess: 1) shadow mode in staging (emit canonical but consumers still read provisional) -> 2w. 2) internal canary -> 1w. 3) billing parallel run and diff checks -> 72h. Owners: routing/sharding (pradeep), audit-store (eva), reprocess tooling (jess).
eva: +1
pradeep: +1
